summary: Pine Tree Acquisition Corp., a Cayman Islands blank-check company (Nasdaq: PAXGU/PAXG/PAXGR), filed an 8-K disclosing consummation of a partial over-allotment exercise by underwriter Maxim Group LLC: 600,000 units at $10.00 each for $6.0 million gross. Each unit comprises one Class A ordinary share and one right to three-fourths of a share upon an initial business combination. Concurrently, 24,000 ordinary shares were issued to a Maxim-designated entity. Total trust proceeds reached $106.0 million. No target or deal was announced; watch for combination announcement and redemption dynamics.
